name: patreon-caption-customizer
description: Move, resize, and recolor captions/subtitles on video streaming sites (Patreon, Vimeo, Streamable, and hls.js/Shaka/Video.js/Plyr/JW Player based players) with a draggable overlay. Ships as a userscript and as Chrome/Opera and Firefox extensions, all built from one source.
author: Charles M.

scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build && npm test
